title: I-Trust ephathiswe uMlambo
intro: Umphefumlo wawujongene nomyalelo ongenakwenzeka, apho ubomi bosana olusandul’ ukuzalwa babuxhomekeke esikalini. Bekhokelwa yimpembelelo kaThixo, umyalelo onzima wawuthotyelwa, kwaye imfihlo exabisekileyo yabekwa emsinga, kodwa yabuyiselwa ngendlela engalindelekanga.
clues: Ndandiphila phantsi komthunzi womlawuli olawula ukubulawa kwamakhwenkwe asandul’ ukuzalwa.
Umoya oyingcwele wandifikela, wandiyalela ukuba ndithathe inyathelo elibuhlungu nelibuhlungu.
Ndabeka usana lwam oluxabisekileyo ebhokisini ndaza ndalubeka phezu komlambo oqukuqelayo.
Intliziyo yam yaba yintlango, ndaza ndaphantse ndayityhila imfihlo, kodwa uAllah womeleza ukuzimisela kwam.
Ndithumele umntu ukuba alandele uhambo lomntwana ezantsi komsinga njengoko umsinga wawuthwala isifuba.
Umntwana wafunyanwa yindlu yaloo mlawuli ukhohlakeleyo, ekugqibeleni, ndadibana nomntwana wam ndaba ngumondlikazi.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko

trial.answer: Wabeka umntwana wakhe ebhokisini waza wamfaka emlanjeni

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
